item.title: At least 68 killed in Spanish high-speed train crash
item.description: At least 68 people were killed when a high-speed train slammed into the rear of another train that had stopped on the tracks in central Spain on Wednesday morning, in the country's second deadly high-speed rail collision this year. item.title: No clear winner in Israel election as Netanyahu's bloc falls short of majority
item.description: Israel's election has produced no clear winner, with Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's Likud party emerging as the largest single party in the Knesset but his right-wing bloc falling short of a governing majority. Israelis surged to the polls at a turnout of more than 77%, and partial results…

item.title: Supreme Court upholds Trump administration's ability to block immigration judges' closures
item.description: This dispute centers on a procedural immigration-court tool called 'administrative closure,' which let judges pause deportation cases—for instance, so a migrant could pursue asylum or other relief through a separate federal process. item.title: Lilly's retatrutide beats Ozempic in head-to-head diabetes trial
item.description: Eli Lilly announced Wednesday that its investigational drug retatrutide outperformed Novo Nordisk's Ozempic in a large Phase 3 clinical trial of adults with type 2 diabetes. In the head-to-head study, patients on the highest dose of retatrutide achieved a 2.2 percentage-point reduction in blood…

item.title: SK Hynix's blockbuster earnings, $75 billion shareholder-return plan boost memory-chip optimism
item.description: SK Hynix, South Korea's memory-chip giant, reported blockbuster earnings late Tuesday and unveiled a $75 billion shareholder-return plan, lifting shares of Micron. The results crushed expectations and come as the sector springs back from recent lows.

item.title: Rays force World Series Game 5 with 12-inning walk-off win over Brewers
item.description: ST. PETERSBURG, Fla. — Pinch-hitter Ben Williamson singled home the winning run in the bottom of the 12th inning, and the Tampa Bay Rays staved off World Series elimination with a 4-3 victory over the Milwaukee Brewers on Tuesday night, forcing a Game 5.
